languageDescription: Choose English or Bangla for buttons, menus, and other app text. Item names and notes stay as you entered them.
timezoneDescription: Event logs, discussions, and notifications display in this timezone. Calendar dates (due dates, planned work) stay as entered.
timeFormatDescription: Choose 24-hour clock or 12-hour with AM/PM for time pickers across the app.
productionMachinePicksDescription: When assigning a machine to a batch step, choose warn-only or block rules for off, maintenance, and schedule overlap.
pageGuidesDescription: First-visit walkthroughs on Orders and other pages. Reset to see them again.
savedStampDescription: Draw or upload a personal stamp to place on attachment markups.
time24HourHint: Off uses 12-hour clock with AM/PM in time pickers.
pageGuidesResetHint: First-visit walkthroughs run once per page. Resetting replays them the next time you open each page.
resetGuidesAllDescription: This clears seen walkthroughs for every workspace on your account. Tours will auto-run again on first visit to each page.
pageGuidesResetWorkspaceSuccess: Page guides reset for this workspace
pageGuidesResetAllSuccess: Page guides reset on all workspaces
machinePickSoftDescription: Always allow picks. Warn for off, maintenance, another in-progress step on the machine, or overlapping planned windows.
machinePickBlockUnavailableDescription: Refuse off or maintenance. A second live step and plan overlap only warn.
machinePickBlockOverlapDescription: Refuse off, maintenance, or a machine that already has another in-progress step. Planned window overlap still only warns.
machinePickOwnerOnly: Only the workspace owner can change this policy.
stampIntro: Save one personal stamp to place on attachment markups. This is not a legal e-sign — it is an overlay mark only.
shiftsDescription: Wall-clock windows for batch planning. End before start means overnight (e.g. 22:00–06:00). Windows cannot overlap.
shiftsEmpty: No shifts yet. Add one below for batch chips on Production.
